subject: general
question: Which of the following are common sedimentary rocks?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sandstone, limestone, and shale**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandstone**, **limestone**, and **shale** are all common types of sedimentary rocks.
 
• **Sandstone** is composed mainly of sand-sized mineral particles or rock fragments.
 
• **Limestone** is primarily made of calcium carbonate, often from marine organisms.
 
• **Shale** is a fine-grained sedimentary rock that forms from the compaction of silt and clay particles.
 
• These rocks are typically formed through the deposition and subsequent cementation of material at the Earth's surface and within bodies of water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Type of Sedimentary Rock
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Clastic**
 Formed from mechanical weathering debris.
 
 

 **Chemical**
 Formed when dissolved minerals precipitate from solution.
 
 

 **Organic**
 Formed from the accumulation of plant or animal debris.
